verdict.rationale: Loops documents building audience segments [loops-docs-31] and sending campaigns to them [loops-docs-51]. It states that segments are dynamic and stay current as properties change [loops-docs-16], which covers live segmentation on profile attributes; a user also asks for better filtering [loops-comm-2]. Missing for 10: evidence that segments can filter on tags or behavioral events (events are documented only as workflow triggers), detailed segment-builder documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
